issues: M11 acceptance tests fail: ledger entry hash for PDF export has empty code string (expected 12‑hex chars) – likely appendEntryForExport does not store the correct code or compute it per spec (R27).

M11: CSV export verification line format does not match expected pattern (expected 76‑char string <entryCount>,<headHash>,<verificationCode> but got a shorter string) – generateCsv produces wrong verification line (R26, R27).
M11: CSV verification after tampering returns null instead of a failure result – verifyExportCode likely not handling altered file correctly (R32).
M11: PDF export creates ledger entry with missing verification code – same issue as CSV export (R27, R28).

M8: ledger verification does not detect tampering – verification returned ok:true when ledger was altered (tests expect false) – verifyLedger logic incorrectly reports out‑of‑order as "out‑of‑order" instead of "prevhash mismatch" and may not correctly detect missing entry or changed field (R18‑R19).
M8: detection of reordered entries reports wrong firstBadSeq (expected 2 but got 1) – verifyLedger's seq continuity check is flawed (R18).
M8: detection of incorrect prevHash reports "out‑of‑order" reason instead of "prevhash mismatch" (test expects reason containing "prevhash").
M11: Settings screen does not show verified status (test for Settings ledger status fails) – SettingsScreen may not be invoking verifyLedger on mount (R24‑R25).
M11: Verify export flow does not correctly locate matching ledger entry for PDF code – verifyExportCode likely mis‑implemented (R31‑R34).
M11: Backup round‑trip verify test expects 2 ledger entries but only 1 is present – initLedgerIfNeeded may not be adding imported entries for existing receipts/mileage on first launch (R11‑R12).

UI flow test fails: Save receipt button remains disabled because required fields are not considered valid (e.g., amount field empty after clearing) – ReceiptEntryScreen validation or UI flow does not enable the Save button as expected (R5‑R7).
feedback: The implementation of the ledger, export verification, and UI flow is incomplete or incorrect. Several acceptance tests fail due to missing or malformed ledger entries, incorrect verification line formats, and faulty verification logic. Ensure ledger entries are recorded on receipt/mileage creation, edits, deletions, and imports per spec (R5‑R10, R11‑R12). Compute hashes using canonical JSON and set prevHash correctly (R15‑R17). Implement verifyLedger to detect tampering, missing, reordered entries, and mismatched prevHash with proper reasons (R18‑R19). Append export.created entries with correct format, code, entries count, and headHash (R26‑R28). Update SettingsScreen to display verification status (R24‑R25). Implement VerifyExportScreen and export verification functions to handle CSV and PDF codes correctly (R29‑R34). Ensure backup includes ledger and restore verifies it (R35‑R39). Finally, adjust UI flow and screen validation so Save receipt button becomes enabled after required fields are filled (R5‑R7). Fix these issues and re‑run tests.
